name: Mint Chocolate Chip I 200mg Hash Rosin Cone
description:
Mint Chocolate Chip I 200mg Hash Rosin Cone I Covert Cups 
A refined take on infused indulgence. Covert Cones™ pair crisp sugar cones with a rich chocolate center, infused with premium solventless hash rosin to deliver 200mg THC per cone. Crafted with intention and consistency, each cone offers a dessert-forward flavor profile balanced by smooth, full-bodied effects. 
Mint-flavored milk chocolate filled cone topped with refreshing Andes mints. 
Available in 7 carefully curated flavors, Covert Cones™ are designed for those who appreciate craftsmanship, flavor, and potency in one discreet treat.
